symptom: after the git merge mx version check (mendixlabs/mxcli#1977), a merge was refused although the project's exact mx was installed, whenever another version's mx was on PATH; and `--mxbuild-path` naming a folder without an mx ran the mx on PATH under the override, with only a warning
cause: docker.ResolveMxForVersion tries PATH before an exact-version install or cache, and when --mxbuild-path holds no mx it falls back to PATH; the version check sat after the resolver, so it refused the PATH mx instead of looking for the right one, and the override applied to an mx nobody named
fix: without --mxbuild-path take docker.LocalMxForVersion (exact install or cache, never PATH) first, then the resolver plus the check; with it, refuse an mx that does not lie under the named path (a file path stands for its folder); warn when the project's version is unknown, as marketplace package does
insight: a version check placed after a preference-ordered resolver turns every resolver fallback into a refusal or an override; the exact-version lookup has to come before the resolver, not after it. marketplace package has the same PATH-first refusal
